429 Rate limit exceeded for image generation

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import CreateImageRequest
from liter_llm import LiterLlmError, RateLimitedError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        req = CreateImageRequest.from_json('{"model":"dall-e-3","n":1,"prompt":"A cat","size":"1024x1024"}')
        await client.image_generate(req)
    except RateLimitedError as error:
        print(f"RateLimitedError: {error}")
    except LiterLlmError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
